calls.statement:
SELECT 
  dp.subcategory,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE ds.store_id = 118
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
GROUP BY dp.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
